claim: In the success branch, result.ui_component is non-None and has a rich_component attribute when is_answer_marked(result.ui_component.rich_component) is evaluated

evidence: agent.py:998 guards with `if result.ui_component:`; the success branch (else at 1026) is inside it, so line 1031 only runs with a truthy ui_component. UiComponent (core/components.py:14-53) is a pydantic BaseModel with no __bool__/__len__, so any instance is truthy. rich_component is a required field (`...`) and validate_components (line 39) raises unless it is a RichComponent, so the attribute always exists on a constructed instance.

claim: answer_prose_emitted is set only for a tool result yielded on the success path; a failed emit_text (success=False, e.g. blank text) yields no marked component and does not set it
verify_against: EmitTextTool.execute error path and agent.py's failure branch before the else at ~1026
verify_hint: Check EmitTextTool.execute and EmitTextParams validation in src/sqllens/agent/tools/emit_text.py, and the if/else on result.success in agent.py around 1010-1032
evidence: agent.py: answer_prose_emitted is initialized at 667 and assigned only at line 1032, inside the else branch (1026-1032) of `if not result.success` (1000), so only successful results can set it; failed results go through the error branch (1024-1025), which never touches the flag. Grep shows no other assignment. emit_text.py: EmitTextParams._non_empty (39-47) rejects blank text at validation (registry returns success=False before execute); execute's except returns structured_tool_error (_errors.py:31-61), which builds success=False with an unmarked NotificationComponent. So a failed emit_text yields no marked component and does not set the flag. Absolute-claim input traced: blank text -> validation failure -> error branch -> flag unset.

claim: The prompt asserts that the final reply is shown only when no emit_text call has succeeded in this request, and is NOT shown once one has succeeded
source_excerpt: Your final reply (the text you write when you stop calling tools) is NOT shown once an emit_text call has succeeded in this request. It is shown only when no emit_text call has succeeded in this request.
verify_hint: Falsifying input: no emit_text success but the result has a truncation notice or isError, or the iteration-limit path; check agent.py ~1121-1130 and components_to_blocks in src/sqllens/tools/_format.py
evidence: agent.py:667 initialises answer_prose_emitted=False per request. agent.py:1026-1032: only on result.success with a ui_component, if is_answer_marked(rich_component) (markers.py:37-44, strict data['is_answer'] is True) it sets answer_prose_emitted=True; failed results (else branch at 1000) never set it. emit_text.py:93-105 is the only marker producer on a tool result and returns success=True with the marked TEXT; its failure path returns structured_tool_error (no marker). End-of-turn branch agent.py:1121-1141: response.content and answer_prose_emitted -> final reply only logged and saved to history, not yielded; elif response.content -> yielded with answer marker. So the final reply is shown iff no emit_text succeeded. Falsifying input considered: no emit_text success but truncation notice or isError result -> flag stays False, reply shown (matches the claim). Iteration-limit and argument-failure paths (1063, 1144) produce no model final reply; the limit warning is a system message, not the 'final reply' the prompt describes. components_to_blocks (_format.py:352-362) does not itself hide anything; it renders marked TEXTs, consistent with the agent-level rule. Prompt text at default.py:135 matches.

claim: Test helper grants UI_FEATURE_SHOW_TOOL_ARGUMENTS to DEFAULT_USER_GROUP the same way factory.build_agent does, so failed tool status cards reach the block builder as in production
source_excerpt: # Same UI-feature grant as factory.build_agent, so a failed tool's error
verify_hint: Check build_agent in src/sqllens/agent/factory.py for register_feature calls and compare to the test's _query_database helper
evidence: factory.py:163-173 builds UiFeatures(), takes the existing UI_FEATURE_SHOW_TOOL_ARGUMENTS groups, appends DEFAULT_USER_GROUP if missing, and calls register_feature. It passes ui_features into AgentConfig (factory.py:196). The test helper (tests/unit/test_emit_text_final_reply.py:83-98) builds UiFeatures(), registers the same feature with the existing groups plus DEFAULT_USER_GROUP (imported from sqllens.agent.factory), and passes it into AgentConfig(ui_features=...). The only difference is that the test does not dedupe the group. Duplicates have no effect on membership, so the grant is equivalent.

claim: EmitTextTool with text '   ' returns a failed result (not a validation exception that aborts the request) so the loop continues to run_sql
verify_against: EmitTextParams validator and registry argument-validation path
verify_hint: Check EmitTextParams in src/sqllens/agent/tools/emit_text.py and ToolRegistry argument validation / consecutive_argument_failures handling in agent.py
evidence: EmitTextParams._non_empty (emit_text.py:39-47) raises ValueError for whitespace-only text. ToolRegistry.execute catches any Exception from args_model.model_validate (core/registry.py:208-218) and returns ToolResult(success=False, error='Invalid arguments: ...'), not an aborting exception. agent.py:1056-1060 counts a round of all-argument-failures as one consecutive failure; the stop threshold is MAX_CONSECUTIVE_ARGUMENT_FAILURES = 3 (agent.py:62), so a single blank emit_text does not stop the loop and the next round (run_sql) resets the counter. The test test_final_reply_shown_after_failed_emit_text_and_recovered_query (tests/unit/test_emit_text_final_reply.py:152-162) scripts _emit('   '), _sql, final reply and expects the reply shown, consistent with this.

claim: The hidden final reply is appended to the conversation history as an assistant message before the yield/skip branch, on every path where answer_prose_emitted is True, and is persisted so the next request includes it
verify_against: Agent.send_message end-of-turn branch and conversation save
verify_hint: Check the code just above line 1119 in agent.py that appends the assistant Message and where the conversation is saved to ConversationStore
evidence: agent.py:1106-1114: in the end-of-turn else branch, conversation.add_message(Message(role='assistant', content=response.content or '', provider_content=...)) runs whenever response.content or provider_content, unconditionally before the answer_prose_emitted check at 1119 (comment 1117-1118 says never skip it). The 1119 branch only logs; the elif at 1125 yields. The only other add_message sites are the tool-call branch (703), tool results (1052) and the user message (529), so no hidden-reply path bypasses the append. The conversation is then saved at 1187-1198 via conversation_store.update_conversation, gated by config.auto_save_conversations (default True, config.py:119). The argument-failure break at 1083 has no final reply to hide. Absolute-claim input traced: response.content non-empty with answer_prose_emitted True, which is appended then persisted. Only an operator turning auto_save off skips persistence, which is configured behavior.
